reason: I like making my own trades, and Robinhood and Public already let me do that for free. I'm not paying a monthly fee, at a price they won't even name, so an AI pet can move my real money around.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money, especially from a new app that doesn't even have a broker yet. If it makes a dumb trade, a downloadable log doesn't get my money back.
would_change_my_mind: Knowing which licensed, SIPC-covered broker actually holds the money, plus a few months of the demo agent's record clearly beating what I do on my own.
